d: Cristiano Ronaldo has beaten Lionel Messi in the B.O.A.T. vote to decide the greatest Ballon d'Or-winning season of all time. The Al-Nassr superstar's 2008 Manchester United campaign came out on top, ahead of Messi's record-breaking 2012 season. But with fans paying to cast their votes, the result has sparked a debate about football's greatest rivalry, Ronaldo's legacy and the difference between popularity and sporting achievement. Rupha Ramani looks at what this special Ballon d'Or poll really says about one of football's biggest icons.
